title: Dungeon Fighter II Re-Tournament
description: Dungeon Fighter II Re-Tournament — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Sir Tified Luhny

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kill 30 Ice Orok Slayers, 30 Toxic Mutant Pukers, 30 Frosty Orok Mystics, and 30 Toxic Mutant Unipsychos and Return to Sir Tified Luhny on Level 5 of Widower's Nest.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Sir Tified Luhny

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: The Widower's Nest

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Kill 30 Ice Orok Slayers, 30 Toxic Mutant Pukers, 30 Frosty Orok Mystics, and 30 Toxic Mutant Unipsychos and Return to Sir Tified Luhny on Level 5 of Widower's Nest.

Offer:

Word has reached the Widow Maker that we have devastated her Dungeon Fighter II crew. Now she is training the next in line to replace her losses and it is up to you to stop her.

She is picking the best of the best to bring up to the elite Dungeon Fighter II level. She has hand picked the trainees, but we have a list of them that I will give to you now. Find and kill all Ice Orok Slayers, all Toxic Mutant Pukers, all Frosty Orok Mystics, and all Toxic Mutant Unipsychos. When you have done this return to me, Sir Tified Luhny, here on Level 5 of the Widower's Nest.

Turn-in:

I knew I could count on you to handle this task. Here is a reward for you. If you aren't sick of this yet, let me know and you can continue. 10... 9.... 8.... 7....

Objectives:

  • Slain Ice Orok Slayers
  • Slain Toxic Mutant Puker
  • Slain Frosty Orok Mystics
  • Slain Toxic Mutant Unipsycho

Level range: 33–40
